coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset) and mixed age (12 months to 21 years; predominantly paediatric). Lorlatinib registered as four interventions (Lorlatinib; Lorlatinib with chemotherapy1; Lorlatinib with chemotherapy 2; Lorlatinib post Radiation), collapsed to one agent row covering all four arms. Backbone chemotherapy components are not registered interventions but every patient in those arms receives them (R9); listed as soc_backbone, one row per component per regimen (vincristine and cyclophosphamide appear in both). Lorlatinib is the only investigational agent, hence experimental_monotherapy; trial regimen combination because two arms add chemotherapy and one adds radiotherapy (the monotherapy arm alone would be monotherapy). Glioblastoma named in conditions alongside other HGG types. H3K27-altered appears only in conditions, not recorded as a biomarker.
